teaser: The flickering sign above a used bookshop keeps buzzing, and nobody else seems to notice it. You do, because a life path 1 crossed with an ENFJ notices what needs fixing and feels obligated to be the one who fixes it. The 1 wants to lead from the front; the ENFJ wants everyone to arrive there together. So you end up carrying both the map and the group, certain you could draw a better route than the one everyone else is using, and quietly responsible for making sure nobody falls behind on the way.
excerpt: Her hand hovers over the hospital waiting room chair beside you, deciding whether to sit close or give you space, and you realize you have not said which one you want.
